verdict.rationale: Browser Use is built around natural-language task instructions (e.g. run.create with a plain-English goal, GitHub examples like 'Fill in this job application...' or 'Extract structured data...') showing the core agentic workflow is driven entirely by NL commands, corroborated by community hands-on use. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of NL command robustness across diverse tasks, and more detail on failure/error handling when NL instructions are ambiguous.
